scope_description.value: Convert existing Buildings 2102 and 2074 at NAS Patuxent River, MD into Accredited Secured Facilities. Building 2074 to be converted to an ICD-705-1 SCIF (Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility) with Wall Type A Sound Group 4, RF shielding per CNSSAM TEMPEST/1-13, man trap, secure doors, and related TEMPEST countermeasures. Building 2102 to be converted to an 'Open Secret' (below-SCIF classified) operational workspace. Both buildings to receive new split-system heat pumps with spiral ductwork (replacing existing), new plumbing (removal of restroom fixtures and water heater), electrical power distribution (400Hz 3-phase, 28VDC conversion/generation systems), LED lighting, VCT flooring, data/communications infrastructure, and fire alarm. Interior demolition of all existing systems, walls, ceilings, and finishes. Contractor to provide design-build CAD drawings at 30%/60%/100% government review milestones.
scope_description.quote: Modify existing Office space to meet the current version of ICD-705.1and ICD 705 Technical Specifications for Construction and Management of Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (Tech Spec) "Wall type A, Sound Group 4" as determined by the AO / LSO.

sheets.title: Building 2074 User Requirements Matrix
sheets.reading_notes: Single-page user requirements sketch/matrix for Building 2074. Shows conceptual floor layout with TV monitor placements (3x wall-mounted 60-inch TVs in multiple locations). Documents SCIF construction requirements: Wall Type Alpha (2 layers inside block meeting exterior requirements), 60dB ultra-radiant RF shielding (Chapter 3), 6-sided box with STC-50 ceiling, metal hollow doors meeting RF requirements, man trap, non-conductive breaks, grounding. Power requirements: 400Hz 3-phase AC and 28VDC conversion/generation systems with 13 connections, power track/outlets every 5 feet, outlets at 5.5-ft AFF for monitors (11 total). IT/communications: 16 unclassified drops (3-port) + 16 classified drops (3-port), conference room Teams + classified VTC. Other: LED lights, kitchenette (fridge, sink, millwork), VCT flooring. Note: asks whether the two buildings can share power via duct bank. Not a formal drawing — a client requirements capture document.

sheets.title: Building 2102 User Requirements Matrix
sheets.reading_notes: Single-page user requirements sketch/matrix for Building 2102, designated 'Open Secret' (below-SCIF classified space). Shows TV monitor placements (5x 60-inch TVs on one wall, 3x and 3x on others, 8-ft garage door). Power requirements: 400Hz 3-phase AC and 28VDC with 9 connections, similar power track layout. Mechanical: rough cooling estimate 330,583.814 BTU/h (flagged as very rough). IT/communications: 15 unclassified + 15 classified drops, conference room Teams + classified VTC. Other: LED lights, open ceiling painted black, add 8-ft wide garage door at rear, sound-deadening wall material, frost windows, VCT flooring, block walls with patch and paint, kitchenette. Not a formal drawing — a client requirements capture document.
